description: This file defines a ValidatorActionFilter class that implements the IActionFilter interface to validate the model state in ASP.NET Core MVC controllers. If the model state is invalid, it serializes the errors into JSON and returns a 422 response.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: A class implementing IActionFilter to validate model states before actions execute and handle invalid states by returning JSON errors with HTTP status 422.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Checks if the model state is valid; if not, constructs an error response with serialized JSON errors and sets the HTTP status to 422.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: Empty implementation, required by the IActionFilter interface.
